replay.detail: No new projection invalidation or startup replay trigger in the merged phone raw/key terminal-input fencing change.

schema.detail: No database table, index, trigger or migration change in phone raw/key terminal-input fencing; SQLite user_version is unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digest/drop policy are unchanged; this change adds no sealing coordination requirement.

compatibility.detail: Raw/key terminal.input is fenced by runtime incarnation without requiring a matching screen sequence. Line input and resize retain sequence fences. New phone builds fall back to read-then-send when an old daemon requires a sequence; both an upgraded phone and the daemon it connects to are needed to remove that old typing failure.

downtime.detail: No additional upgrade service stop or measured outage introduced by phone raw/key terminal-input fencing; the standard daemon/client restart procedure still applies.

manual.detail: Update the phone client and its connected member for reliable typing into a frequently redrawing terminal. Existing line/resize consumers must keep their screen-sequence fence; raw/key consumers may omit it on new daemons.

recovery.detail: No additional recovery procedure introduced by this change. Preserve graph state, keys and configuration and follow the standard roll-forward guidance; this note does not qualify binary-only downgrade of the whole release.
